title: The included bounded site mate equals the ambient mate after realization
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, g:Z -> Y a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes, and H a bounded-below etale A-complex. Let N be the exact derived etale-to-pro-etale comparison, E the intrinsic realization, I the intrinsic site functor, a:I isomorphic to N followed by E its specified comparison, P intrinsic derived direct image, Q fixed-scalar pro-etale derived direct image, R etale derived direct image, d:P E_Z isomorphic to E_Y Q the normalized realization/direct-image comparison, and beta:N_Y R -> Q N_Z the ambient counit mate. Then properSiteIso(A,g,H).hom equals a_Y at R(H), followed by E_Y(beta_H), d inverse at N_Z(H), and P(a_Z inverse at H). This uses exactly the existing specified comparisons, with no replacement of definitions. The specified D+ mate and its counit normalization are those of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]; the intrinsic coordinates and ambient mate are those of [def-finite-compact-scalar-coordinates] and [def-sf-etale-proetale-ambient-direct-image-comparison].

proof.text: Use the included-site calculation sp_comparison_hom, whose only mathematical input is the specified D+ direct-image counit normalization of lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate. The D+ inclusion compatibility for exact functors, right-derived functors and their adjunction counits identifies the included morphism with the ambient counit mate. The BoundaryComparison definitions in that private proof are aliases for the exact derived pullback square, not uses of exceptional inverse image or the later projection theorem.

Whisker the equality by intrinsic realization and the source and target site-functor identifications. Unfold properSiteIso and spDirectImageComparisonIso; the resulting composites agree factor by factor.

theorem properSiteIso_hom_ambient
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact g] [QuasiSeparated g]
    (H : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)))) :
    (properSiteIso A g H).hom =
      (intrinsicSiteFunctorIso A Y).hom.app _ ≫
        (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y A).functor.map
          ((ProEtale.directImageComparisonAmbient (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) g).app H.obj) ≫
        (sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison g A).inv.app
          ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) Z).mapDerivedCategory.obj H.obj) ≫
        (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage g A).map
          ((intrinsicSiteFunctorIso A Z).inv.app H.obj)
